versions.changelog:
- Added WebAbility MCP support for scanning pages and HTML for accessibility issues across WCAG 2.2, ADA, Section 508, EAA, and AODA.
- Added a workflow for framework-aware fixes and re-scanning to verify changes.
- Documented optional account tools for visual and full audits, plus tools for contrast, ARIA, rule lookup, and scan comparisons.
- Added guidance to report only tool results and avoid claiming full compliance.
